Build is clean now (0 errors). Two real bugs from the bump, both in `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js`:

- `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }` — fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `isBackoffEnabled` treated `undefined` as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false` — fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

The remaining ~950 lines of DEP/WARN output are just noisy deprecation logging from the fake bundler itself, not related to your code — those aren't something to "fix," just verbose logging from the tool.
